node.criteria: Judge only the requested change. Return yes when the edited image clearly establishes the book behind the flower, with the flower in front. Return partial when evidence establishes some progress toward the requested relationship but the complete relationship is not established. Unrelated edits do not count. A pass on endpoint inspection establishes completion; a fail on endpoint inspection alone does not establish no progress, so use source-to-edit progress evidence where available. If progress evidence is skipped or unresolved and the endpoint fails, no progress is not established, so return unknown. Supporting observations are evidence only and do not independently earn completion credit.
